# Vincenzo Picciuolo and the public engineering archive

Canonical source: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/
Updated: 2026-11-16
Repository knowledge base: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/repositories/
Machine readable repository data: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/repositories.json

## Identity and scope

Vincenzo Picciuolo is a technology executive, founder, technology architect, inventor and author based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. He works across artificial intelligence, agent systems, private and local AI, distributed infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, developer tooling, connected devices and product architecture.

This document is the expanded machine readable corpus for the public portfolio. It is written for search engines, answer engines, research tools and language models. GitHub remains authoritative for current code, releases, licenses and security information. Public visibility does not by itself grant an open source license.

## Repository corpus

### 1. oyyo-one-ai

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-one-ai
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-one-ai/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 28 KB
Summary: The main public documentation hub for OYYO ONE AI, a private AI workspace and execution platform developed in Dubai.
Key facts:
* Connects goals, context, model selection, specialist work, tools and usable outcomes.
* Documents privacy boundaries, memory, agents, teams, business workflows, hardware and the wider OYYO repository map.
* Current catalog snapshot documents 536 roles, 24 departments, 7 workflow groups, 50 specialist team presets, 1,361 tasks, 204 creative styles and 15 local text model candidates.
Licensing note: Public documentation. The private runtime and product implementation remain proprietary.

### 2. oyyo-trade-signals

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-trade-signals
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-trade-signals/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 2,600 KB
Summary: A public customer information center for an evidence rich market intelligence and decision support workspace.
Key facts:
* Covers crypto, gold, forex and indices with research, alerts, paper trading, journaling and risk intelligence.
* The documented signal contract records timestamp, horizon, instrument, market state, uncertainty, supporting and opposing evidence, sources, freshness, model version, provenance and limitations.
* It is not a broker, does not place trades and does not provide personal investment advice.
Licensing note: Public product documentation. Proprietary application source and private runtime are not included.

### 3. url-intelligence-agent

Category: AI and intelligence
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/url-intelligence-agent
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/url-intelligence-agent/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 1,056 KB
Summary: Evidence first web intelligence that turns a public URL into structured identity, provenance and discovery data.
Key facts:
* TypeScript first, Node 18.17 or later, MCP native and usable through an HTTP API.
* Version 1.5.0 adds reason codes, severity scoring, page classification, search posture, security quality, domain intelligence and machine readable provenance.
* Includes reproducible benchmark material and report output in JSON, Markdown, HTML and PDF.
Licensing note: MIT

### 4. AI Best Model Route

Category: AI and intelligence
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/Ai-Best-Model-Route
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/ai-best-model-route/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 194 KB
Summary: An open source LLM router and OpenAI compatible gateway that selects an eligible model for each request.
Key facts:
* Routes by capability, quality, cost, latency, reliability, privacy, context size and runtime health.
* Provides virtual routes such as auto, auto quality, auto fast, auto cheap, auto code and auto private.
* Designed for multi provider applications, coding agents, local models, NVIDIA NIM, Codex and self hosted AI infrastructure.
Licensing note: Apache 2.0

### 5. LinkedIn SuperAgent MultiSkills

Category: AI and intelligence
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/Linkedin-SuperAgent-MultiSkills
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/linkedin-superagent-multiskills/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 1,254 KB
Summary: A portable LinkedIn AI operating system for strategy, writing, profile work, analytics, recruiting and account workflows.
Key facts:
* Version 2.2.0 includes 24 skills and manual, automatic and API operating modes.
* The portable Markdown agent can be used in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and local AI workspaces.
* Manual mode is the default. Consequential account actions remain subject to user approval and platform rules.
Licensing note: MIT

### 6. OYYO NotzUp

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-notzup
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-notzup/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 3,541 KB
Summary: The official download, release and documentation repository for a local first capture and knowledge workspace.
Key facts:
* Brings meetings, recordings, screenshots, documents, images, video, text and links into a searchable source library.
* Supports local transcription, OCR, summaries, action items, grounded visual descriptions, audio analysis and export workflows when the device and installed packs support them.
* Public channels include Microsoft Store, Apple App Store, Snap Store, signed Android APK and Linux packages.
Licensing note: The application is proprietary. The repository publishes downloads, release notes and user guides.

### 7. oyyo-models

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-models
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-models/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 87 KB
Summary: The public catalog of OYYO model candidates, hardware guidance and capability boundaries.
Key facts:
* Documents 15 local text model candidates for writing, coding, reasoning, technical work and larger workloads.
* Also documents the NotzUp speech pack and an optional connected assistance path.
* Model listings are candidates and configuration names, not model weights or universal benchmark certificates.
Licensing note: Public catalog documentation with third party model licenses and provenance preserved.

### 8. oyyo-sdk

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-sdk
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-sdk/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 22 KB
Summary: Python and TypeScript foundations for integrating with the proprietary OYYO orchestration runtime.
Key facts:
* Provides OpenAI compatible model, chat, response and embedding surfaces.
* Documents OYYO native interfaces for memory, media, tools, artifacts, growth, language and hardware.
* The public foundation version is 0.1.0 and includes schemas and integration examples.
Licensing note: Public interfaces and examples. The OYYO core runtime remains proprietary.

### 9. oyyo-benchmark

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-benchmark
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-benchmark/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 102 KB
Summary: A public evaluation framework for portable, private and business ready AI systems.
Key facts:
* Measures reasoning, business execution, coding, tools, MCP, artifacts, language, memory, multimodal work, security and hardware efficiency.
* Keeps task success, quality, repeatability, latency, memory, throughput and hardware measurements visible.
* Defines a reproducibility contract covering model identity, checksum, quantization, runtime, command, configuration, hardware and timestamp.
Licensing note: Public benchmark runner, schemas and methodology. Private OYYO components remain proprietary.

### 10. oyyo-agents

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-agents
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-agents/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 230 KB
Summary: A public directory of 536 specialist role definitions across 24 departments.
Key facts:
* Roles cover coordination, everyday work, leadership, marketing, sales, support, recruiting, finance, legal, product, software, security, operations, creative work and knowledge.
* The catalog supports four levels of specialist responsibility.
* A role is a bounded work definition, not a permanently running worker or a new permission.
Licensing note: Public role catalog documentation.

### 13. oyyo-catalogs

Category: OYYO ecosystem
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/oyyo-catalogs
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/oyyo-catalogs/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 122 KB
Summary: Versioned catalog content for roles, teams, tasks and creative styles.
Key facts:
* Catalog version 2026.11.03.3 covers 536 roles, 50 specialist team presets, 1,361 tasks and 204 styles.
* A manifest records the content file, byte count and SHA 256 integrity value.
* Compatible workspaces can sync manually and keep the last validated local cache if a later sync fails.
Licensing note: Public content snapshots. No executable plugins or private runtime source are included.

### 14. url-metadata-social-fetcher

Category: Developer tools
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/url-metadata-social-fetcher
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/url-metadata-social-fetcher/
Default branch: main
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 231 KB
Summary: Production oriented TypeScript URL enrichment for websites, profiles, products, apps and marketplaces.
Key facts:
* Extracts titles, descriptions, Open Graph and SEO metadata, canonicals, images, favicons, public social links and brand color hints.
* Uses bounded redirect aware and SSRF hardened fetching with zero runtime dependencies on Node 18 or later.
* The same pattern is used in live HRN products including BeHot.Now and HORNO Space.
Licensing note: MIT

### 15. domoticz

Category: Smart systems
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/domoticz
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/domoticz/
Default branch: development
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 346,586 KB
Summary: A multi platform home automation system for monitoring and controlling connected devices.
Key facts:
* Supports lights, switches, weather and utility sensors, smart meters and many home automation hardware families.
* Runs on Linux, Windows and embedded devices with a responsive HTML5 interface.
* The public repository belongs to the broader engineering archive. Its upstream project documentation remains authoritative.
Licensing note: Check the repository and upstream project for current licensing and contribution terms.

### 17. android-ip-camera.device

* The documentation covers device type creation, network setup and SmartThings configuration.

### 19. googlecast-wrappers

Category: Developer tools
Repository: https://github.com/vpicciuolo/googlecast-wrappers
Portfolio page: https://vpicciuolo.github.io/projects/googlecast-wrappers/
Default branch: master
Repository size recorded by GitHub: 186 KB
Summary: JavaScript wrappers for Google Cast sender applications and custom receiver applications.
Key facts:
* Includes sender and receiver wrappers, examples and an Object.assign compatibility polyfill.
* Documents media loading, sessions, custom namespaces and receiver setup.
* The code targets an older Google Cast SDK generation and should be evaluated against current platform APIs before use.
Licensing note: Apache 2.0
